rounds.fact: Its thick carbon dioxide air traps heat like a greenhouse.

rounds.q: One spin of Venus: higher or lower than 225 days?

voice.hook: It's Higher or Lower, space edition, with two rounds on Venus. Try to beat the clock.
voice.q0: Mercury's days can hit 800 degrees Fahrenheit. Venus is farther from the Sun, so is its average temperature higher, or lower?
voice.r0: It's higher. Venus averages about 847 degrees, because its thick atmosphere traps the heat.
voice.q1: Venus takes 225 Earth days to circle the Sun. Is one spin on its axis higher, or lower?
voice.r1: It's higher, at 243 Earth days. Venus spins slower than it travels around the Sun.
voice.outro: How many did you get? Follow Liftoff for more.

facts: Mercury: daytime temperatures can reach about 800°F (NASA Space Place, Weather on Other Planets)
Venus: average temperature about 847°F; its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat (NASA Space Place)
Venus: one orbit of the Sun takes 225 Earth days; one spin on its axis takes 243 Earth days (NASA Space Place, All About Venus)
